title: devex
text:
devex

raj: Running an example edge build and noticed our app pulled in ~700KB of node shims after updating the JS SDK. error was `ReferenceError: global is not defined` on load.

claire: Did the package start shipping a CJS fallback or a top-level require? those will pull in node builtins. Check package.json exports + sideEffects.

raj: package.json had main/module but no exports. dist/index.js re-exports everything and contains a small helper that references Buffer at module scope.

toni: module-scope references break tree-shaking. Move node-only helpers behind dynamic imports or into a separate entry that consumers only get via `require('./node')`. Also add `sideEffects: false`.

claire: Also add conditional exports so `import` resolves ESM browser build explicitly, e.g.:
```
"exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" } }
```

raj: After changing to exports + sideEffects:false and adding a small browser.mjs that avoids Buffer, bundle dropped ~600KB and the edge deploy worked.

toni: We should add a tiny edge smoke test to CI that builds the example app with esbuild/rollup and fails if gzipped > 250KB. Also document: "avoid top-level node imports, split types, explicit exports, set sideEffects" in SDK guidelines.

build-bot: deploy attempt on branch sdk-edge-fix — build passed, size check OK (gzipped 198KB). :white_check_mark:

raj: I'll open a PR template and a short devex doc for onboarding sample apps. thanks! :raised_hands:
